brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of LID104 in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of LID104 in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: National, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Triple-dummy, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of LID104 in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus
